## Goal
- Execute and certify production release reconciliation, OTP-secure member registration/authentication, owner authorization, primary AI execution, CI, Render deployment, and web/Android/iOS SHA parity for `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `https://github.com/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Diagnose the GitHub `401` cause before changing authentication; use minimum required permissions and approved owner/GitHub App flow if token repair is unsafe.
- Do not expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal test identities in chat, logs, commits, or terminal output.
- Do not lose, overwrite, reset, delete, or remove approved code/features without explicit evidence and authorization.
- Create a recovery branch and backup tag before reconciliation; this is explicitly authorized.
- Do not deploy until plaintext OTP persistence is removed and required OTP tests pass.
- Do not certify any release property without external, SHA-matched, verifiable evidence.
- Final acceptance requires GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live `/version` SHA.
- If any acceptance item is unproven, final output must begin `PRODUCTION NOT YET VERIFIED` and list only missing proof, exact blocker, owner action if needed, and next executable step.

## Progress
### Done
- Re-probed public production surfaces:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/health → 200
  https://api.ivxholding.com/version → 200
  https://ivxholding.com → 200
  ```
- Production `/health` and `/version` identify the live backend as:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  bootTime=2026-08-03T11:49:24.393Z
  ```
- Production self-reports healthy AI/provider/runtime status:
  ```json
  {
    "status": "healthy",
    "aiStartupValidation": {
      "ok": true,
      "provider": "vercel_ai_gateway",
      "model": "openai/gpt-4o"
    },
    "seniorDeveloperRuntime": {
      "github": {"canReadRepo": true, "canPush": true},
      "render": {"canDeploy": true}
    },
    "ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalVerification": {
      "verified": true,
      "executionPath": "github_git_data_api"
    }
  }
  ```
  - This is runtime self-reporting, not independent GitHub/Render provenance.
- Anonymous production owner-route rejection was executed:
  ```text
  GET https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/autonomous/qa → 401
  {"ok":false,"error":"IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token."}
  ```
- Invalid production registration request was rejected without creating a member:
  ```text
  POST /api/members/register → 400
  {
    "ok": false,
    "code": "INVALID_EMAIL",
    "stage": "VALIDATING",
    "message": "First name and last name are required."
  }
  ```
- Confirmed production registration/login endpoint limits in `backend/hono.ts`:
  ```text
  member-register: limit 5, refill 0.3
  member-login: limit 5, refill 0.5
  member-forgot: limit 3, refill 0.1
  ```
- Local OTP-security repair applied in `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`:
  - Replaced `Math.random()` generation with `randomInt(0, 10)`.
  - Added salted `scrypt` hashes and `timingSafeEqual`.
  - Replaced fallback `FallbackCodeRecord.code` with `codeHash`.
  - Added `MAX_RESENDS = 3`.
  - Changed Supabase `verification_codes.code` writes/comparisons to hashes.
  - Removed OTP code from `VerificationResult`.
  - Enforces expiry, single-use state, failed-attempt limit, and resend limit.
- Local registration contract repair applied in `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`:
  - `gender` is optional.
  - `confirmPassword` mismatch is rejected before registration.
- Local validation completed:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit → PASS
  bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts → 38 pass, 0 fail
  ```
- Earlier local checks remain evidenced:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run lint   # Expo; warnings only
  node scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
  {"status":"ok","version":"1.9.4","landingReferences":4}
  ```
- Public-chat smoke request previously passed:
  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/public/chat → 200
  answer="The answer is 4."
  persistence=supabase
  ```
  - Response reported `source:"fallback"`; primary-model execution remains unproven.

### In Progress
- Diagnose and repair canonical GitHub authentication; retrieve repository metadata, default branch, canonical HEAD, commits, PRs, workflow runs, and job results.
- Audit current checkout reconciliation state: branch, local/remote HEAD, status, untracked/modified files, ahead/behind commits, stashes, submodules/gitlinks, remotes, and worktrees.
- Add/verify focused OTP regression coverage for hash-only persistence, expiration, single use, retry limits, resend cooldown, rate limiting, log redaction, safe errors, enumeration resistance, and expired-record cleanup.
- Run complete SHA-matched QA: backend/Expo type checks, lint, unit/integration/auth/authorization/OTP tests, web E2E, Android E2E, iOS tests, production build, autonomous-coder regression, and rollback-safety regression.
- Verify primary AI credentials/runtime binding, primary response, safe provider recording, retry/timeout behavior, and Supabase persistence.
- Execute authorized production member and owner flows only after secure test-session access is available.

### Blocked
- Canonical GitHub authentication is unavailable:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/user → 401
  ```
- Canonical private repository lookup without valid credentials returns:
  ```text
  GET https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform → 404
  ```
- Exact cause of the `401` is not yet diagnosed; account identity, token validity/scopes, GitHub App installation permissions, SSO authorization, branch protection, Actions permissions, and canonical remote access remain unverified.
- Local checkout remote is not directly canonical GitHub:
  ```text
  origin=https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- Canonical GitHub Actions, commit graph, PR/review/merge status, CI URLs, artifacts, and deployment statuses cannot be independently verified.
- Render service/deployment IDs, Render API evidence, and GitHub HEAD ↔ Render SHA parity cannot be independently verified.
- No approved authenticated member or owner session is available; real production registration completion, OTP retrieval/verification, member/owner sign-in, reset completion, owner-module access, and authenticated Supabase inspection cannot be performed.
- Android production build, iOS approved test environment, web browser E2E, Android emulator, and iOS simulator flows have not been executed for the live SHA.
- Live production SHA `012bb088...` cannot contain current local OTP/registration repairs until canonical commit, review/merge, deployment, and parity verification occur.
- Full backend/Expo suite totals and required mobile/web E2E results are not captured for a single final SHA.
- Historical canonical workflow evidence for `012bb088...` included:
  ```text
  Android release consistency: failure
  Android release APK: skipped
  Playwright E2E (web surface): skipped
  IVX E2E Acceptance Pipeline: failure
  Android Emulator QA: failure
  Lint: failure
  TypeScript typecheck: failure
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Do not mark production VERIFIED until all 12 user acceptance conditions are externally evidenced on one exact SHA.
- Treat `/health` and `/version` only as evidence that SHA `012bb088...` is live; do not treat runtime self-reporting as GitHub/Render provenance.
- Do not deploy the existing live OTP fallback as certified: plaintext fallback risk must be repaired, tested, merged, and deployed first.
- Preserve local work; create required recovery branch and backup tag before any pull/rebase/merge reconciliation.
- Do not create a real production test member without authorized secure handling for verification and record inspection/cleanup.
- Anonymous `401` proves missing-credential rejection on one owner route only; it does not prove authenticated member denial across owner features.
- Do not certify public chat while `source:"fallback"` is reported.

## Next Steps
- 1. Safely diagnose GitHub `401` without revealing secrets: verify authenticated account is `ibb142`, token/App validity and permissions, repository access, SSO, branch protection, Actions permissions, and canonical remote.
- 2. Retrieve canonical repository metadata, default branch, HEAD SHA, commit history, PRs, workflow runs, and job conclusions after access is repaired.
- 3. Inventory local Git state; create recovery branch and backup tag before fetching/reconciling canonical history.
- 4. Review local commits and modifications; preserve approved IVX changes, integrate latest canonical production branch, resolve conflicts, and run required tests.
- 5. Complete focused OTP tests, including persistence behavior for Supabase and schema-missing durable fallback, before deployment.
- 6. Commit approved changes with a clear release message; push approved branch, open/update PR, complete required review, and merge to the production branch.
- 7. Trigger/verify complete CI on final merged SHA; repair every failure and rerun on that exact SHA.
- 8. Deploy exact approved SHA to the canonical Render production service; record deployment ID; verify `/health` and `/version`, restart service, and reverify SHA parity.
- 9. Using approved secure sessions, run controlled production member registration, email/phone verification, duplicate checks, sign-in/reset/session tests, authenticated owner-route rejection, and sanitized Supabase mapping verification.
- 10. Verify owner sign-in, server-side role enforcement, owner modules, logout/relogin, persistence, and expired-session handling.
- 11. Repair and evidence primary AI execution without fallback, including Supabase persistence and safe provider telemetry.
- 12. Build and test web, Android, and iOS from the final SHA; capture versions, build IDs, timestamps, API URL, launch, registration, member sign-in, and owner sign-in evidence.
- 13. Return only the requested verifiable final evidence package; otherwise return `PRODUCTION NOT YET VERIFIED` with only unmet proof/blockers/owner action/next step.

## Critical Context
- Current live production identity:
  ```text
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  deploymentMarker=ivx-owner-ai-hono-autodeploy-live
  ```
- Latest local commit previously observed:
  ```text
  615fcd97045fcf6978e47d7aeed09d4e2ff69aa6
  Updated member registration features and verified system status.
  ```
- Earlier claimed local commit remains different from production:
  ```text
  2b262204efb2f8c6cd7ed87a519b83cb83a52e93
  ```
- Local `main` was previously ahead of configured router remote by three commits; production SHA `012bb088...` was absent from local object database.
- Local working tree last observed:
  ```text
  M backend/api/ivx-members.ts
  M backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts
  ```
- Existing deployed OTP policy source declared:
  ```text
  CODE_TTL_MINUTES = 10
  CODE_LENGTH = 6
  MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5
  ```
- Current local OTP repair adds:
  ```text
  MAX_RESENDS = 3
  CODE_HASH_PREFIX = 'scrypt'
  ```
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts` retains schema-missing fallback and filesystem/durable-store behavior; schema/runtime persistence and expired-code cleanup require focused testing before deployment.
- `getSupabaseAdmin()` in member/registration services permits anon-key fallback when service-role configuration is absent; real production RLS and server-side authorization require validation.
- Production registration/verification routes:
  ```text
  /api/members/register
  /api/members/send-email-code
  /api/members/verify-email
  /api/members/send-phone-code
  /api/members/verify-phone
  /api/members/login
  /api/members/forgot-password
  /api/members/verification-status
  ```
- Expo release consistency currently reports version `1.9.4`; final Android/iOS/web build evidence must be regenerated from the approved merged SHA.
- Required final evidence includes canonical repository URL, repaired GitHub access, production branch, final SHA, reconciliation summary, changed files, PR, CI URL/results, test totals/timestamps, Render IDs/SHA, health/version, SHA parity, Supabase project reference, sanitized auth/registration evidence, AI primary-provider evidence, and platform build evidence.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/services/ivx-member-verification.ts`: OTP generation, Supabase/durable fallback persistence, verification policy, and hash-only OTP repair.
- `backend/api/ivx-members.ts`: registration validation, verification, and login handlers; optional-gender and confirmation-password repairs.
- `backend/hono.ts`: production member routes and rate-limit wrappers.
- `backend/services/ivx-member-database.ts`: Supabase member/auth operations and service-role/anon-key selection behavior.
- `backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`: idempotent registration orchestration and member-role persistence.
- `backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts`: registration reliability tests and targeted 38-pass run.
- `backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts`: autonomous deployment rollback regression coverage and targeted 38-pass run.
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: owner authorization guard and response controls.
- `expo/shared/ivx`: trusted request/session resolution used by owner authorization.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml`: backend tests, Android release consistency, and APK build workflow.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: root/Expo type checks, Expo lint, and Playwright web E2E workflow.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-qa-suite.yml`: backend/Expo tests, critical-file test, production QA matrix, evidence generation, and artifacts.
- `expo/app/login.tsx`: member/owner login and recovery UI.
- `expo/app/owner-access.tsx`: owner access and password-reset UI.
- `expo/app/reset-password.tsx`: reset-password UI.
- `expo/package.json`: Expo test/build scripts.
- `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs`: Expo/Gradle/landing APK version consistency validation.
- `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`: Android APK/QR release references.
- `expo/app.config.ts`: Expo app version source, currently `1.9.4`.
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: Android version source checked by release-consistency validation.
